enabled.name: Enable TBG
enabled.hint: Master switch for speech bubbles and speech modes. Narrator mode and the chat theme have their own switches.

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Print verbose TBG logs to the browser console. This client only.

bubbleLayout.name: Bubble stacking
bubbleLayout.hint: Free flow: a new bubble only pushes the bubbles it overlaps, so distant groups form their own columns. Line by line: every bubble on the scene moves up.

bubbleRiseSpeed.name: Rise speed
bubbleRiseSpeed.hint: Screen pixels per second that bubbles drift upward. Zero keeps them in place until newer bubbles push them.

bubbleRiseLimit.name: Rise limit
bubbleRiseLimit.hint: Screen pixels above the token after which a bubble fades out.

bubbleMaxWidth.name: Maximum bubble width
bubbleMaxWidth.hint: Width in pixels before the text wraps. Habbo uses 240 (thin) and 350 (normal).

bubbleMaxLifetime.name: Maximum lifetime
bubbleMaxLifetime.hint: Seconds before a bubble fades regardless of position. Zero disables the limit.

bubbleScaling.name: Bubble scale
bubbleScaling.hint: Screen: bubbles keep the same size at any zoom level. World: bubbles scale with the map like the core bubbles.

bubblePortrait.name: Portrait in bubbles
bubblePortrait.hint: Show the token image inside the bubble, next to the name, like the avatar head in Habbo.

autoInCharacter.name: Speak in character automatically
autoInCharacter.hint: With a token selected (or an assigned character), plain text is posted in character even when the message mode is Public as User. Commands and the mode picker still work as usual.

typingIndicator.name: Show who is typing
typingIndicator.hint: While someone writes, an ellipsis badge appears in the corner of their token. It disappears when the message is sent, when the input loses focus, or after three seconds without typing, even if text is left in the input.

usageBubbles.name: Sheet action bubbles
usageBubbles.hint: When someone uses an item, a feature or a roll from their sheet, in any system, a beige bubble appears over the token: "Kirito used Longsword". Only the action's name, never the result.

narrationBanner.name: Narration banner
narrationBanner.hint: Every GM narration also shows as a large banner in the middle of the screen, for everyone, rising slowly until it fades.

narrationBannerDuration.name: Minimum banner time
narrationBannerDuration.hint: Seconds the banner stays on screen. Longer texts stay longer, up to 30 seconds.

narratorName.name: Narrator name
narratorName.hint: Name shown on narration messages. Leave empty for "Narrator".

narratorActive.name: Narrator mode
narratorActive.hint: Whether this client is currently narrating.

chatTheme.name: Chat theme
chatTheme.hint: Portraits, author colors and message kinds on the chat cards. This client only.

chatGrouping.name: Group consecutive messages
chatGrouping.hint: Hide the header when the same speaker posts again within five minutes.

Narrator.name: Narrator
Narrator.toggleHint: Plain text you send is posted as the Narrator instead of the selected token.
Narrator.on: Narrator mode on: plain messages are posted as the Narrator.
Narrator.off: Narrator mode off: the selected token speaks again.

Errors.noSpeaker: Select a token or assign a character before speaking in character.
